description: A Spring Boot REST controller defining basic application endpoints including welcome, documentation redirection, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: REST controller providing endpoints for welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message for the API.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects the user to the Swagger UI documentation page, preserving the original request scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a simple 'OK' string indicating application health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns general information about the online shopping mall system.
